heading.title: Renovation & Carpentry Projects in British Columbia
heading.text: A look at renovation and carpentry projects by VV Renovation, from commercial build-outs and residential finishing in Greater Vancouver to timber walkways and stairs at Moutcha Bay Resort on Vancouver Island. Explore our carpentry, framing, drywall finishing, flooring and painting work.

projects.title: Yoga Studio Renovation in Langley
projects.imageAlt: Finished commercial yoga studio renovation with black mats and mirror wall in Langley, BC
projects.description: A full commercial studio build-out: framing, drywall and ceiling work, self-leveling, vinyl tile and yoga mat installation, decorative wall panels and detailed finishing.

projects.title: Luxury Home Preparation in Jericho Beach
projects.imageAlt: Finished curved white hallway with glass spiral staircase railing in a luxury Jericho Beach estate, Vancouver
projects.description: Seasonal preparation of a high-end Vancouver estate: interior painting of curved walls and ceilings, stucco and concrete crack repair, exterior repainting, hot tub assembly and detailed handyman work.

projects.title: Interior Renovation in Whistler
projects.imageAlt: Finished smooth white Level 5 walls and angled ceiling with a wood-framed forest window in a renovated Whistler chalet
projects.description: A full chalet interior renovation: demolition of tile, stone and marble, framing, drywall, Level 5 finishing and painting — executed with precision across sloped ceilings and complex angled geometry.

projects.title: Custom Carpentry at Moutcha Bay Resort
projects.imageAlt: Overview of Moutcha Bay Resort on a forested Vancouver Island hillside
projects.description: Timber walkways, wooden stairs, landings and railings around the forest cabins, fitted to the wooded hillside and existing trees.
